incidenti_noti: Estonian government websites were temporarily blocked by DDoS attacks querying them several thousand times the normal traffic flow

contesto_generale: In the first quarter of 2022, Estonia continued to deal with the ongoing COVID-19 pandemic. On 18 February, Estonia delivered a shipment of U.S.-made FGM-148 Javelin anti-tank missiles to Ukraine. On 26 February, Estonia announced that it would close its airspace to all Russian airlines. On 2 March, Estonia voted on a United Nations resolution condemning Russia for its invasion of Ukraine. The Estonian cargo ship MV Helt sank near the Port of Odesa in the Black Sea on 3 March following an explosion, but all crew members were rescued. An investigation into the incident was announced by Estonian Foreign Minister Eva-Maria Liimets.
